title: The Syntax ’26 Performance Pass
notes: Profiler-led performance cleanup across sample playback, modulation, filters, synths and master processing.
New DUEL filter for sample instruments; FRAY panel artwork, DAC waveform and Ghost indicators.
Revised FRACTURE factory filter behaviour; existing patches retain their previous filter behaviour.
Separate Windows, H700 and factory library downloads. Back up your data folder before updating.
Alpha limitations remain: performance varies, H700 acceptance testing is pending, and older save-staging errors are unresolved.

title: First alpha — proof of concept
notes: First public experimental build of Contour – Visual Tracker.
Exploring horizontal tracking, synthesis and sampling, generative visuals, customisation and the CONT sharing concept; not every system is complete or available.
Expect bugs and audio or performance issues. Song files may change before beta and may not be backward-compatible.
Download the alpha build and report problems through GitHub Releases and Issues.
